transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for fitting me in. 

Um, I hope I'm explaining this right, but... I guess what really brought me in is just that my mind kind of won’t stay on one thing anymore. It's probably normal to get a little scattered sometimes, but lately at the bench—I'm a jeweler—I'll just jump from reading a customer email, to looking at a saw mark on a piece of metal, to some random noise outside... and then I realize I’ve completely lost track of the whole work order I was supposed to be doing. 

I just don't want to mess up at work or let anyone down, you know? Does that... is that the kind of thing I should be coming here for?
When you think back to childhood, were you already someone who had trouble staying focused?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I was pretty average, I think. I didn't really have trouble paying attention in school or anything like that. I actually liked focusing on the little details, which is probably why I ended up making jewelry. 

I was a pretty good kid, always tried to do my homework and follow the rules. I didn't want to cause any trouble for my teachers or my parents. So, yeah, this feeling of being so easily distracted... it's kind of new for me. I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Well, um... I guess I wouldn't say I'm, like, severely depressed or anything. I'm still getting up and going to work every day. But... I don't know, maybe a little down? 

These past couple weeks, I've just been waking up with this... heavy, kind of hollow feeling. It's almost like the shine has just gone out of everything, even the pieces I usually love working on. I mean, it's embarrassing to admit, and I hope you don't think less of me, but... I've actually cried in my truck a few times before opening the shop. 

I just wipe my face and go in because I don't want the customers to see, but... yeah, it's been a little tough. Is that... does that sound like depression to you, or just a normal slump? I really want to give you the right answer here.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Well, um... I guess maybe a little bit? Like I mentioned, the jewelry making hasn't been as exciting lately, but... I don't want it to sound like I've just given up on everything. I'm still trying my best to stay engaged, you know? 

I still like seeing my friends sometimes, and I try to keep up with my hobbies... it's just that the feeling I get from them isn't quite as strong right now. It's probably just a phase, right? I mean, everyone gets a little bored sometimes. I hope I'm not making too big a deal out of it. Am I answering your question okay?
Did something particularly stressful happen in your life shortly before these symptoms started?

Well, um... I've been racking my brain trying to figure that out myself, to be honest. But... no, not really. Work at the shop has been fine, no big fights with anyone, nothing like that. 

I actually feel a little guilty about it, because I know people go through some really terrible things, and here I am, just... feeling this way for no good reason. I almost wish I had a better excuse for you so it would make more sense. I hope it's okay that I don't really have a specific trigger to point to? I just want to be completely honest with you and not make something up just to justify how I've been acting. Is it normal for this to just happen out of nowhere?
Have you been worrying a lot more than usual lately?

Well, um... I wouldn't say I've been worrying *a lot* more, no. I mean, I have the usual stuff on my mind, like keeping the shop running and making sure the customers are happy with their pieces. But... nothing out of the ordinary, I don't think. 

I try really hard not to let things get to me too much. I don't want to be a burden on anyone by constantly stressing out, you know? So, I think I'm doing okay in that department. I hope that's the kind of answer you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you an accurate picture of what's going on.
Have you had any recent medical illness or injury?

Well, um... no, nothing like that. I've been pretty healthy, honestly. No hospital visits or major injuries or anything. 

I try to take good care of myself, you know? Eat right, get enough sleep when I can... I don't want to cause any extra trouble for anyone by getting sick. So physically, I think I'm doing just fine. I hope that helps rule out anything complicated? I'm really trying to be as helpful as I can with all your questions.
Have you been having trouble with your memory lately?

Well, um... I guess maybe a little bit? I don't want to make it sound worse than it is, because I'm still getting my work done. But... I have noticed that sometimes I'll stare at a repair ticket, or like, a tray of sapphires, and I just... I can't seem to hold the measurements in my head long enough to decide what to do next. 

It's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly. I usually pride myself on being really sharp with those details. I just sort of lose my train of thought for a second. It's nothing too terrible, I promise, and I always double-check my work so I don't mess anything up for the customers. Is it okay that I'm struggling with that a little? I hope it doesn't make me sound incompetent or anything.
Have other people noticed that your memory or concentration has been worse lately?

Well, um... no, I don't think anyone has really noticed. I mean, I work pretty independently at the bench most of the day, so it's mostly just me and the stones. 

If I do have a little slip-up or need to reread a ticket, I just handle it quietly. I really try not to let it show, you know? I wouldn't want my boss or the customers to think I'm not paying attention or that I don't care about their pieces. I always make sure the final product is perfect before anyone sees it. So... I think I've done a good job of keeping it under wraps. I hope it's alright that I haven't told anyone at work about it? I just want to keep things running smoothly for everyone.
Have you started any new medication or supplement recently?

Well, um... no, I haven't started anything new. No medications or supplements or anything like that. I really try to just keep things simple, you know? 

I wouldn't want to take something over-the-counter that might mess up whatever you're trying to figure out, or make your job harder. So I just stay away from all those extra pills and powders and just try to drink enough water. I hope that's okay? I mean, if there's a vitamin or something you think I really should be taking, I'd definitely be open to it. I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing here and giving you a clean slate to work with.
Have you noticed any trouble finding the right words when you speak?

Well, um... no, I don't think so. I mean, maybe every once in a while I'll pause for a second, but nothing out of the ordinary, I promise. 

I feel like I can still explain things clearly to the customers when they come in to ask about a repair or a custom setting. I really try to be careful with how I talk to people, because I want them to feel confident leaving their jewelry with me. So, I make sure to speak clearly and use the right terms. I haven't noticed any real issues with finding my words, thankfully. I hope that's a good sign? I'm trying my best to stay on top of everything.
Have you been feeling down like this nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Well, um... yeah, I guess it's been a little while now. I really didn't want to admit it to myself, but... this whole feeling down and, I don't know, just feeling guilty all the time... it's been hanging over me for about a month, I think. 

I've tried so hard to just push through it and keep smiling for the customers, you know? I really didn't want to be a burden or seem like I was complaining. I kept hoping it would just pass if I worked harder. I'm sorry if I should have come in sooner. I hope it's not too late to figure this out? I just want to get back to being myself and doing a good job.
Have you noticed your appetite has changed lately?

Well, um... no, my appetite has been pretty normal, I'd say. I mean, I still try to make sure I eat my meals and keep my strength up for work. 

I don't want to get weak or shaky when I'm working with the tiny tools, you know? So I make a point to eat lunch, even if it's just a sandwich or something small. I haven't noticed any big changes, like eating way too much or totally skipping meals. I really try to take care of myself that way. I hope that's helpful to know? I'm doing my best to keep a good routine going.
Have you been waking up much earlier than usual and unable to fall back asleep?

Well, um... I guess my sleep hasn't been perfect lately, if I'm being completely honest. I always try to get into bed at a normal hour, because I know how important it is to be sharp for work, but... I just kind of toss and turn for a while. 

And then, yeah, I have been waking up pretty early, like before dawn. My mind just starts racing about work, like this one missed delivery we had, and I just can't seem to turn it off and go back to sleep. When I finally drag myself out of bed, I really don't feel rested at all. I'm sorry, I know I should be managing my stress better so I can sleep. I'm trying to fix it, I promise. Is it normal to get stuck on things like that when you're trying to sleep?
